summary: Verified ARIADNI ID card-creation consolidation flow. TEST 1-5 all pass: 'Create Card' + 'Create your first card' both navigate to /templates studio; 12 industry choices present; step-1→step-2 auto-advance on industry click; preview reflects industry and updates live as fullName is typed; publish + save-draft both create cards in Your Cards with correct status; direct /templates loads at Step 1; inline CardEditor for existing cards has slug/accent/published/save but NO editor-template (correctly removed); feras-askar public profile still renders. Header 'industry-templates-link' correctly removed. Test cards were created and cleaned up; feras-askar untouched (save without modification).

issues: Horizontal overflow detected (documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth). Likely caused by the sticky header row with 'Card Manager' back link + 'Create Your Card' title + 'Save Draft' + 'Publish Card' buttons all on one row. Consider stacking/collapsing header controls on <sm breakpoints.

action_items: Fix mobile (390px) horizontal overflow on /templates studio header — stack Save Draft / Publish Card buttons or hide labels on small viewports.
Investigate 4 x 404 resource errors in console on the flow (likely missing image asset). Not blocking but should be cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateCard.save() derives slug from fullName if empty — good. But it does not check slug uniqueness client-side; backend will 4xx if duplicate — surface a friendlier message.

CreateCard has no explicit step-3 data-testid on the wrapper other than the stepper button 'step-3' — acceptable but note editor-fullname is reached only via to-information; consider allowing users to jump directly back to step 3 via the stepper (currently works).
Admin.jsx passes navigate('/templates') for both new-card-button and empty-new-card — consolidation is clean, no duplicate creation path remains.
CardEditor.jsx correctly omits templateId select; editor-template testid is NOT present in DOM (verified).

success_rate.backend: n/a (not directly retested; card CRUD used indirectly via UI, all succeeded)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 temp cards (qa-real-*, qa-tech-*) during TEST 1 & 2, both cleaned up via delete API. feras-askar saved without changes (no data drift).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Creation flow consolidation is fully working. Only remaining polish item is mobile (390px) header overflow on /templates. All data-testids referenced in review request are present and behave as expected. The card-item testid format is 'card-item-{slug}' (the review's mention of 'card-item-template-hub-184' appears to be a slug/domain confusion — actual pattern verified is card-item-{slug}).
rca of the issue: Mobile /templates overflow RCA: The <header> renders 3 button/label groups in a single flex row with gap-3 and px-4 padding on min-w-390 viewports. On mobile the 'Create Your Card' center label + Save Draft + Publish Card buttons together exceed 390px. Fix: apply flex-wrap or hide the center title on sm:, or use icon-only buttons on mobile.
